request.title: Process Superwhisper daily log entries into structured Obsidian notes
request.initialDescription: Throughout the day I use Superwhisper to dictate unstructured voice notes into my Obsidian daily log — a stream-of-consciousness brain dump. A post-processing step (currently AI-assisted but ad-hoc) needs to extract structure from this raw text: atomic Todos, Topic notes, named Entities, dated Permanent notes (one idea per note, full sentences), tags and links between notes, and prompts for Overview/Summary notes. The output is imperfect but far more useful than my previous system of random post-its, envelopes, and unreadable notebook scrawls.
request.currentProcess: Dictate into Superwhisper throughout the day; Superwhisper appends transcriptions to the Obsidian daily log. Periodically run an AI post-processing step manually to extract structure. Review and correct the outputs by hand.
